title: Foundation of the Pala Dynasty
subtitle: Bengal's transition into a major imperial phase.
summary: The Pala dynasty emerged in the mid-8th century, with Gopala's rise during a period of political disorder. Under Dharmapala and Devapala, the dynasty expanded significantly and made Bengal a central actor in wider South Asian politics.
heroTagline: Pala state formation linked Bengal to a wider imperial and Buddhist world.
whyItMatters: This event matters because it marks the beginning of a durable Bengal-based dynasty with long political reach and major religious-intellectual patronage.
